articles.headline: McKinsey: Medtech Needs More Than a Market Rotation to Win Back Investors
articles.summary: McKinsey diagnoses why medtech has lagged despite a supportive macro rotation, pointing to structural headwinds including reimbursement compression, slowing procedure volumes, and product cycle lulls that a simple multiple re-rating cannot overcome. The report outlines what investor-credible value creation actually looks like for medtech management teams navigating these pressures. It serves as a framework for differentiating names with genuine operating levers from those relying on macro tailwinds.
articles.why_it_matters: For investors holding medtech names like BSX or ISRG, this framework sharpens the question of whether a thesis rests on structural earnings power or merely sector rotation — a critical distinction heading into earnings season.
